question: What is the minimum overall attendance required to be eligible to write semester examinations?
verified_answer: Students must secure not less than 90% of overall attendance in that semester. Students who do not have the requisite attendance will not be permitted to write the semester exams.
verbatim_excerpt: 3. Requirements for Completion of a Semester: 3.1 A candidate who has fulfilled the following conditions shall be deemed to have satisfied the requirement for completion of a semester. He/She secures not less than 90% of overall attendance in that semester. 3.2 Candidates who do not have the requisite attendance for the semester will not be permitted to write the semester.

question: What is the normal and maximum duration allowed to complete a B.E. / B.Tech degree?
verified_answer: The normal duration is 8 semesters (4 years). The maximum permissible period is an extra 4 semesters beyond the normal duration (total 12 semesters / 6 years).
verbatim_excerpt: A student is ordinarily expected to complete the Under Graduate Program in a normal duration of 8 semesters for B.E./B.Tech, 6 semesters for B.Sc., 2 semesters for B.Ed., but in any case not more than an extra of 4 semesters beyond the normal duration of the course.

question: How many working days or instructional hours make up a semester at Sathyabama?
verified_answer: Each semester normally consists of 75 to 90 working days (or 450 to 500 hours maximum).
verbatim_excerpt: Each semester shall normally consist of 75 working days or 500 hours at the maximum.

question: What is the marks weightage breakdown between Continuous Assessment (Internal) and End Semester Examinations?
verified_answer: For theory and practical courses, the evaluation is split equally: 50 Marks for Internal Assessment (Continuous Assessment) and 50 Marks for End Semester Examinations.
verbatim_excerpt: For the batches from 2015: (i) Theory Courses: Internal Assessment : 50 Marks, End Semester Exams : 50 Marks. (ii) For Practical course: Internal Assessment : 50 Marks, End Semester Exams : 50 Marks.

question: What are the requirements to be awarded First Class with Distinction?
verified_answer: A student must pass all courses in their first appearance within the normal 8 semesters for B.E./B.Tech and secure an overall aggregate of not less than 75% (calculated from 3rd to 8th semester).
verbatim_excerpt: A candidate who qualifies for the award of the Degree having passed the examination in all the courses of all the semesters in his/her first appearance within normal duration of 8 semesters for B.E./B.Tech ... and securing an overall % of not less than 75% (Calculated from 3rd to 8th semester for B.E./B.Tech and all semesters for other courses) shall be declared to have passed the examination in First Class with Distinction.

question: How and when can a student apply for paper revaluation after exam results?
verified_answer: A candidate can apply for revaluation of theory exam papers within 2 weeks from the declaration of results through their Head of Department. Revaluation is not permitted for practical courses or project work.
verbatim_excerpt: A candidate can apply for revaluation of his/her semester examination answer paper in a theory course, within 2 weeks from the declaration of results, on payment of a prescribed fee along with prescribed application to the Controller of Examinations through the Head of Department. The Controller of Examination will arrange for the revaluation and the result will be intimated to the candidate concerned through the Head of the Department. Revaluation is not permitted for practical courses and for project work.

question: What time is daily hostel attendance taken, and what are the rules regarding room presence?
verified_answer: Hostel attendance is taken every day from 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM. Inmates must be physically present in their allotted rooms during this window to be marked present.
verbatim_excerpt: Attendance will be taken every day from 6:00 pm to 7:00 pm; Hostel inmates will be marked present only if they are physically present, so they are requested to be in their allotted rooms during this time.

question: What is the evening return curfew for hostel students going on an outing?
verified_answer: Students going on an outing must return to the hostel by 6:30 PM. Inmates are permitted a maximum of 3 outings per month with prior warden permission.
verbatim_excerpt: Students going for outing should return to hostel by 6.30 P.M ... Hostel Inmates shall avail maximum of 3 outings per month with prior permission from hostel warden.

question: Can hostel students stay back in their rooms during class hours?
verified_answer: No inmate is allowed in rooms during class hours, except in case of illness with warden permission obtained before 9:00 AM.
verbatim_excerpt: No hostel inmate is allowed to stay in the hostel room during their class hours; However, in case of illness, student may be allowed to take rest in their room, with the permission of the Warden taken befor 9:00 am.

question: Are day scholars, outside visitors, or outside food permitted in hostel rooms?
verified_answer: No. Entertaining guests, visitors, or day scholars in hostel rooms is strictly prohibited at all times. Bringing outside food into hostel rooms is also not allowed.
verbatim_excerpt: Hostel Inmates are not allowed to entertain any guest / visitor / day-scholar in their rooms at any time. Hostel inmates are not allowed to bring outside food into their rooms.

question: What are the standard bus arrival and departure timings for day scholars?
verified_answer: All buses reach campus before 8:45 AM and depart from campus at 3:30 PM on regular working days.
verbatim_excerpt: All the buses reach the campus before 8.45 A.M. and leaves the campus at 3.30 P.M. in the evening which helps all the students to reach home on time safely.

question: Are there special evening buses for students attending coaching or staying back for library study?
verified_answer: Yes. Special buses depart at 5:00 PM for students attending placement training, civil services coaching classes, or utilizing library facilities.
verbatim_excerpt: Special buses depart at 5.00 P.M. for the students who are attending special classes like civil services coaching classes, placement training classes, library facilities and other activities.

question: What is the minimum training attendance required to be eligible for campus recruitment drives?
verified_answer: Students must maintain a minimum of 90% attendance in placement training programs to be eligible to attend recruitment drives.
verbatim_excerpt: Training attendance should be a minimum of 90% to consider the students for campus placements. The announcements of campus interviews will be delivered through group email and circulars in the class rooms.

question: What is the policy for attending Dream and Super Dream company placement interviews if I already hold an offer?
verified_answer: For Dream Companies (5 to 10 LPA), the CTC difference over your current offer must be at least 1.5 LPA. For Super Dream Companies (>10 LPA), the CTC difference must be at least 3 LPA.
verbatim_excerpt: The companies which offer between 5 LPA and 10 LPA will be considered as Dream Company. One condition to this category is that, if the difference in CTC (Salary – Cost to Company) between the existing offer and the dream offer is less than 1.5 LPA, then those students will not be allowed to appear for the 'dream company' interview. The companies which offer above 10 LPA will be considered as Super Dream companies. The condition to this category is that, if the difference in CTC is between the existing offer and the Super dream offer is less than 3 LPA, then those students will not be allowed for the 'Super dream company' interview.

question: What are the official charges and turnaround times for obtaining duplicate semester marksheets and transcripts?
verified_answer: Semester marksheets cost Rs. 400 per semester; consolidated marksheets cost Rs. 800; Speed Post charges are Rs. 200 within India. The processing turnaround is a maximum of 15 working days from receipt of the form at the COE office.
verbatim_excerpt: Semester Mark / Grade Sheet for all courses: Rs. 400/- per semester. Consolidated Mark / Grade Sheet for all courses: Rs. 800/-. Speed Post Postal Charges (within India): Rs. 200/-. Maximum of 15 working days from the date of receipt of the application form at the Controller of Examinations office.

question: Where can students view and pay their regular semester tuition and hostel fees?
verified_answer: UNAVAILABLE ON PUBLIC PAGES / RESTRICTED TO STUDENT ERP LOGIN. General tuition and hostel fees are not published on open web tables and are accessed individually via the authenticated Sathyabama Fee Portal using Register Number and Date of Birth.
verbatim_excerpt: General tuition and hostel fees are managed individually through authenticated student payment gateways (https://feeportal.sathyabama.ac.in/account/login). Toll-Free Helpline: 1800 - 425 - 1770.
